item.text:
Added view transitions to the gallery. Each product thumbnail and its detail image share a transition name, so the image morphs between the grid and detail page. Page content slides in the direction of navigation, and Suspense skeletons fade into loaded content. The `prefers-reduced-motion` rule disables those animations and the skeleton pulse.

`npm run build` and `git diff --check` pass. I could not visually verify the animations in a browser because this workspace has no browser runner installed.
